status: Fixed offline reproduction protocol; no API execution
scope: offline diagnosis and minimal feedback-memory intervention; no live tutor, network, credentials, GPU or task board

variants.corrected_blocked: All three arms, unchanged answer PPO on independently randomized classes in A64/B128/A64 packets
variants.interleaved: No-tutor diagnostic only; exactly the same 256 packets uniformly shuffled, same updates and pay
variants.recent_feedback: All three arms; add binary correctness replay of 32 previously observed actions per packet from FIFO256, four existing optimizer steps
variants.balanced_feedback: All three arms; same replay loss/batch/steps, reservoir128 per previously observed horizon; sample16 from each once both are observed

minimal_intervention: For retention, change only the selection of stored action/correctness records from FIFO to horizon-balanced reservoirs. Identical model, answer-step count, replay batch size and loss. No stored oracle answer labels or distillation targets.
replay_loss: Unit-weight negative binary log likelihood of the probability assigned to the past chosen action: -correct*log(p(action))-(1-correct)*log(1-p(action)). Sample only pre-packet records; add current committed actions/outcomes afterwards. Label-independent replacement; no correctness-based selection.
data_repair: Independent uniform class target per case from a separate seeded RNG, rejection-sample numeric state conditional on target; independent within-packet shuffle. No deterministic slot class or exact per-packet class-count constraint. Public projection contains only p,v,horizon, excluding IDs, labels, descriptors, all future fields.
teacher: Explicit perfect offline oracle labels for the eight current cases only, acquired after committed answer and ASK decisions. No recorded real responses reused: changed packets/order/query times fail exact-prompt matching and selection validity. Same two-credit synthetic fee and12-query/96-label cap, zero real charge.
ask: Reuse 61->32 ASK/SKIP PPO, initialp.05, four epochs every16packets gamma.98 GAE.95 clip.2 lr.001; reward=(actual committed job income-2*granted ask)/8. Can buy labels for current8 cases only; fixed oracle, no teacher/lesson/subset/task choice.
controls: Identical packet stream and initial answer weights for every arm of a variant/seed; same answer RNG, updates and replay compute. Learned ASK has extra controller updates; no-tutor never buys labels. Equal allowances are not equal actual calls. No policy selection or tuning from results.
diagnostics: Same-p/v counterfactual horizon pairs: label disagreements quantify missing-horizon ambiguity; full public tuples plus deterministic dynamics uniquely identify target
Frozen no-tutor post-return models: supplied horizon versus horizon clamped1; distinguish horizon neglect from environment ambiguity
Same-packets interleaving tests capacity/exposure ordering without extra labels or examples
FIFO versus balanced replay isolates whether retaining earlier feedback helps beyond identical extra replay compute
Per-horizon probes at0,64,192,256; frozen state/RNG checks; correct-label probability and confidence errors
Queries and propensity conditional on remaining affordability/call allowance; label errors are0 by construction; actual help capped and denials separate
integrity_gate: All projections/invariance/query-order tests pass; independent seed-independent slot classifier held-out accuracy <=0.35; max in-sample slot-majority <=0.35 perstream; no identical-class-count packet design; unique train latent tuples disjoint from probes; all oracle targets verify by direct equation; ledgers unchanged; no networking/credential access; no future-outcome input

learnability_retention_gate.scope: each of three arms in each of three seeds

learned_help_utility_gate: Separate from basic learnability: learned net income>=1.05*both controls in>=2/3 seeds, with no final macro loss>5pp vs heuristic. Does not make an oracle diagnostic evidence about real noisy LLM tutoring.
stop: No hyperparameter/seed/model changes after results. Stop if integrity fails or balanced feedback misses the predeclared retention/learnability gate. Do not expand the experiment to a task-board comparison or make API calls.
resources: CPU1 nice15; wall600s total; processRSS1800MiB; minimumfreeDisk8GiB; no new dependencies
